jobs.description:
About the role
 

Are you a motivated student with a passion for Human Resources and looking to gain hands-on experience in an international environment? We are looking for an enthusiastic 
HR Intern to join our Benelux HR team.
 

As an 
HR Intern Benelux, you will support the day-to-day HR activities across the Benelux region. Based in 
Belgium, you will regularly provide on-site support at our 
Brussels office as well as at our 
Dutch-speaking production sites.
 

This internship offers a unique opportunity to gain exposure to a broad range of HR processes while working in a dynamic and multicultural organization.
 

 
 

We count on you to:
 
 

• Support the HR team with daily HR administration. 

• Assist & Support onboarding and offboarding activities. 

• Contribute to learning and development initiatives and HR project & HR processes. 

• Prepare and maintain HR documentation. 

• Assist with internal HR communications and employee engagement initiatives. 

• Provide regular support at our Brussels office and Dutch-speaking production sites. 

• Contribute ideas to improve and optimize HR processes.  

 
 

 
 

You can count on us to :
 

During the internship, the HR Intern will receive training in the following areas:
 
 

• HR Fundamentals 

• HR Systems & Digital Tools 

• Operational HR 

• Professional Skills 

• Compliance & Safety  

 
 

 
 

You will bring:
 
 

• You are currently 
pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in human resources, Human Resource Management, Business Administration (HR), Psychology, or a related field. 

• You are based in 
Belgium. 

• You are fluent in 
Dutch, French, and English, both spoken and written. 

• You are organized, accurate, and able to handle confidential information with discretion. 

• You are proactive, eager to learn, and enjoy working in a team. 

• You are interested in gaining practical HR experience within an international organization. 

• You are willing to travel regularly between our Belgian locations.  

 
 

 
 

You will get:
 
 

• A valuable internship in an international and dynamic organization. 

• Coaching and guidance from experienced HR professionals. 

• Exposure to various HR disciplines and projects. 

• A diverse and challenging internship with room for initiative and personal development. 

• An opportunity to build your professional network within the Benelux organization. 

• An Internship allowance and benefits. The Belgian gross monthly allowance can range from 500€ to 1100€.  Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as skills, experience, qualification, type of Internship agreement, internal equity and can ultimately be more or less than the posted salary range.  

 
 

 
 

Additional information:
 
 

• Location: Brussels 

• Duration: 6 months

Sabena Engineering is a leading independent and international aviation solutions provider for civil and military operators. 
 

Our capabilities cover the main aircraft types, including Airbus, Boeing, Lockheed, regional and military aircraft and rotor aircraft. With our unique and innovative solutions to both regular and complex needs, Sabena Engineering is all set to grow as a worldwide proximity partner, bringing its expertise wherever needed. SABCA offers a full range of services to the civil, space and military aviation markets and recently expanded into the commercial Unmanned Autonomous Systems market as an integrator of aerospace-grade solutions for the industry. 
 

Sabena Aerospace & SABCA are part of a unique industrial ecosystem in the Belgian aerospace industry which is owned by Sabena Aerospace (holding company) and by the Société Fédérale de Participations et d’Investissements (SFPI/FPIM).
 

Are you ready to join us?
 

Your Main Responsibilities:
 

Reporting to the Head of Engine Services, you will be required to perform the following: 
 
 

• Engine Incoming Inspection 

• Engine Storage, Humidity Checks and Humidity Corrections 

• Engine Preservation 

• Engine Boroscope inspection 

• Engine Boroblending  

• Engine handling, QEC removal and installation 

• Engine inspection at major module level, Inventory Checks and Lease Return Work Scope (LRWS) / C-Checks iaw B-rating 

• Engine Identification Plug TST/REP iaw C-rating 

• Replacement of external engine parts 

• Maintain and operate ES tooling 

• Maintain and follow-up of local products 
 

• Full understanding of ATA 100 system and working knowledge of interactions between AMM, ESM, CMM 

• Capability of reading, understanding and implementation of service bulletins and airworthy documentation 

• Ability to converse and understand English language at a high level 

• High level of reading and writing technical English is a must 

• High level of computer literacy will be required for daily tasks 

• Have the ability to work within a small team and act independently when required 

• You have a part 66 B1, B1/B2, B1/C or B1/B2/ C license or equivalent shop training/experience on CFM56 and/or V2500 and/or LEAP 1A/1B engines

Bring your office management expertise to a role where you can make an impact from day one, with a wide range of responsibilities and opportunities to shape the workplace experience.

Join Bird & Bird Brussels and play a key role in creating a welcoming, efficient and well-supported workplace within a leading international law firm.

• Dynamic, innovative, and internationally renowned law firm advising clients across sectors including technology, communications, life sciences, financial services, automotive and energy. 
• Established reputation for delivering exceptional service and exceeding client expectations, Bird & Bird is known for helping clients navigate change and seize opportunity.
• International presence with 34 offices across Europe, the Middle East, Asia-Pacific and North America.
• Enjoy a friendly and inclusive work environment based on respect and understanding.
• Comprehensive onboarding to help you settle at your own pace.
• Continuous learning via monthly webinars, training sessions and online resources 
• Realize your career aspirations within this multicultural team, 85 professionals, 10 different nationalities. 
• Modern and attractive offices (presently being refurbished), conveniently accessible by public transport.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=l3U2I59NpoY 

Jobomschrijving

As Office Manager, you will be at the heart of the Brussels office, ensuring that everything runs smoothly. You will combine service excellence and operational responsibility whilst working closely with local and international teams to support the day-to-day running of the office and contribute to wider firm initiatives.

Your Responsibilities

• Manage facilities and office services, ensuring the workplace is well equipped, maintained and ready to support colleagues' daily work. 
• Shape the workplace and employee experience to support team growth by identifying practical opportunities to make the Brussels office more welcoming, efficient and well organised. 
• Lead and develop the reception team, creating a high-quality experience for colleagues, clients and visitors.
• In collaboration with diverse stakeholders (HR, IT, Marketing, the Social Committee as well as international teams) coordinate and deliver office projects and events including client seminars and team building initiatives 
• Build and manage strong supplier relationships, ensuring quality service and value for money. 
• Contribute to Health & Safety, Security, Risk Management, Business Continuity and GDPR  helping maintain a safe and supportive workplace. 
• Encourage ESG initiatives and contribute to the firm's sustainability objectives in Brussels. 
• Participate in the global Office Management quarterly meetings, sharing best practices and bringing innovative ideas to the Brussels office. 

• You have minimum 5 years’ experience in Office Management and an interest in how office management is evolving through new systems and technologies. 
• Excellent English, with good knowledge of Dutch and French
• A proactive and motivating leadership style.
• Clear and confident communication skills.
• A collaborative "one team" mindset, enabling you to build strong working relationships.
• Integrity, professionalism and a strong sense of ownership.
• A creative and practical approach to problem-solving.

Looking for a flexible student job during the academic year 2026-2027?

We are currently looking for enthusiastic and motivated students to join our warehouse team at Katoen Natie Kallo.

You'll start working from mid to late September and begin with a commitment of 2 days per week. This is an excellent opportunity to gain valuable work experience, develop new skills, and become part of a dynamic international logistics company.

What's in it for you?

 
• Flexible student job alongside your studies
 
• Hands-on experience in a large logistics environment
 
• A supportive team and professional guidance
 
• The opportunity to grow within the company

Please note that we cannot guarantee full-time work during school holidays. However, students who show commitment, perform well, and still have sufficient student hours available will have the opportunity to work more frequently during holiday periods and continue their student job throughout the 2027-2028 academic year.

Interested? We'd love to hear from you! Join our team and gain valuable experience while earning extra income during your studies.

 What you'll be doing:
 

 
•  
Willing to do physical work — boxes can weigh between 10 kg and 20 kg.
 
 
•  
You should be flexible to help with all kinds of warehouse tasks, such as loading and unloading, picking, packing, labeling, receiving, and other general warehouse duties.
 
 

English required.

For the campus of DHL in Bornem, we are looking for order pickers with ETP experience and the necessary ETP certificate. You will work in a dynamic team, where you will work in the alternating shift (6 a.m. to 2 p.m. & 2 p.m. to 10 p.m.). 
 

As an order picker, your duties will include the following tasks: 
 

 
• Collecting/picking orders using a ETP
 
• Applying shipping labels to orders
 
• Loading and unloading trucks, this can be either manually or with an electric transpallet (ETP). 
 
• Taking care of administration: this may involve processing delivery notes 
 
• Quality control of goods dn packaging of goods.
 
• We are looking for order pickers who are keen to prove themselves across the warehouse and in any position. 

As an order picker, you can relate to the following description: 
 

 
• You already have experience in the logistics sector.
 
• You have your own transport to get to the warehouse. (Not accessible by public transport )
 
• You are enthusiastic about taking up a new challenge.
 
• You can perform your tasks accurately and correctly.
 
• A real team player.
 
• You are stress-resistant and always remain customer-friendly under difficult circumstances.
 
• You consider quality of paramount importance.
 
• A good basic knowledge of Dutch or English.

Are you a finance enthusiast with a sharp mind for numbers and a proactive attitude? We are seeking a Treasury Assistant for a 6-month temporary contract (replacement mission) within a prominent financial institution located in the European Quarter of Brussels (1040). Reporting directly to the Head of Treasury, you will play a hands-on role in supporting treasury dealers with their daily market and operational activities.  
 

Main Responsibilities
 
 
 
• Money Market Operations: Executing bank-to-bank transfers and performing market transactions, specifically deposits.   
 
• Foreign Exchange (FX) Market: Processing currency exchange requests for clients, executing hedging operations, and closely monitoring market indicators (key meetings, interest rate forecasts, etc.).   
 
• Account & Flow Monitoring: Maintaining constant vigilance over internal account movements, managing incoming emails and requests, and providing prompt support to the Back Office.   
 
• Multichannel Communication: Handling multiple communication channels simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.   

 
 
•   
 
• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Economics, Finance, or an equivalent field.   
 
• Experience: 2 to 3 years of experience, ideally within the banking or financial sector.   
 
• Languages: Business fluency in Italian, French, and English is required (listed by order of importance for daily operations).   
 
• IT Skills: Advanced proficiency in Excel (good level required) and familiarity with Bloomberg.   
 
• Soft Skills: You are proactive, dynamic, and possess a positive, social attitude. You are autonomous, excel at managing priorities, and can maintain your calm during intense, deadline-driven situations.   
 
•

For our client, a company based in Lokeren and active in the foam processing industry, we are looking for an operator.
 

As an operator, you will be responsible for accurately cutting and preparing foam rubber. You ensure that every order meets the required dimensions, shape, and quality standards.
 

Your responsibilities 

- Set up and operate cutting machines and closely monitor the production process. 

- Check the dimensions and quality of the products. 

- Read technical drawings and cutting plans and accurately translate them into practice. 

- Carry out minor maintenance on the machines and independently resolve simple first-line breakdowns. 

- Keep your workplace clean, organised, and safe, and work in accordance with the applicable safety guidelines.

- You speak English very well. 

- You have spatial and technical insight and are strong in math. 

- You work accurately and independently. 

- You are stress-resistant and have a strong sense of responsibility.

Are you looking for a meaningful job where you contribute daily to improving the lives of patients with life-threatening diseases? As a Lab Technician you will work with a passionate team to develop groundbreaking therapies and make a real difference for patients worldwide.
 

Your key responsibilities:
 

 
• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.
 
• Produce clinical and commercial ATMPs through aseptic manual processes, including cell isolation, selection, activation, transduction, culture, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
 
• Perform in-process control tests on batch samples, ensuring high standards for cell counts and viability.
 
• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.
 
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.
 
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste. 

Who we are looking for:
 

 
• You have obtained a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.
 
• Cell culture experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 
 
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.
 
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.
 
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.
 
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.
 
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

Are you ready for a new challenge where your expertise can truly make a difference?
 

If you have a Scientific degree and experience in Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or related field, this is your opportunity to be part of something bigger than yourself. As an Operations Expert, you'll play a key role in manufacturing advanced cell therapies that are transforming cancer treatment and giving patients new hope.
 

Every day, your work will directly contribute to delivering life-changing therapies to patients facing serious diseases. Join a passionate team united by a shared purpose: creating innovative treatments and improving lives around the world.
 

Your key responsibilities:
 

 
• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.
 
• Produce clinical and commercial ATMPs through aseptic manual processes, including cell isolation, selection, activation, transduction, culture, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
 
• Perform in-process control tests on batch samples, ensuring high standards for cell counts and viability.
 
• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.
 
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.
 
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste. 

Who we are looking for:
 

 
• You have obtained at least a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.
 
• Cell experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 
 
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.
 
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.
 
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.
 
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.
 
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

Office Manager (Part-time or Full-time)
 

At Astrape Networks, we’re building the future of sustainable data center solutions. To support our growing team, we’re looking for an experienced, hands-on Office Manager who enjoys ownership, variety, and making things run smoothly behind the scenes.
 

In this key role, you’ll be the backbone of our daily operations: managing our office in Schelle, assisting the management team, and handling a broad range of tasks. 
 

Fluency in English and Dutch is required. The role is based in Schelle, with occasional travel to our Eindhoven office (few times/month).
 

The role can be filled on a 60%, 80% or 100% basis, depending on your preference and availability.
 

How You’ll Make an Impact
 

Office & Facilities
 
 

• Manage daily office operations in Schelle and support the Eindhoven office 

• Coordinate supplies, furniture, maintenance, vendors, and deliveries 

• Own purchasing from request to delivery and issue resolution 

• Handle practical matters such as lunch orders, visitors, and mail  

Administrative & Executive Support
 
 

• Coordinate meetings, events, travel and expenses 

• Prepare and maintain documents and administrative records 

• Manage correspondence, the central mailbox, and internal trackers  

HR & People Support
 
 

• Coordinate onboarding, ensuring equipment and tools are ready from day one 

• Schedule interviews and support candidate communication 

• Provide practical HR and employee support as needed 

Who You Are
 
 

• An experienced Office Manager in a fast-paced environment 

• Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable handling a broad and diverse task set 

• Hands-on, reliable, and able to stay calm when priorities shift 

• Fluent in English and Dutch;  

• Strong administrative skills, with experience in document handling, scheduling, and order processing 

• Ideally living within reasonable distance of Schelle and open to occasional travel to Eindhoven

jobs.description:
As a Bio Process Technician at BBEPP, you choose a job that is truly different. You will work with a team of engineers and technicians on a wide variety of innovative projects. No routine work, but an inspiring environment where you gain new insights, deepen your expertise, and further develop your talents. Together with your colleagues, you scale up and optimize bio-based processes (from lab to industrial scale) that contribute to a sustainable bio-economy and to solutions for today’s and tomorrow’s climate challenges.

In the role of a Bio Process Technician, you are responsible for preparing processes and setting up (pre-) industrial pilot installations. In addition to setting up these test installations, you will also carry out the different process steps and operate the corresponding equipment. In consultation with the process engineers, you closely monitor the process parameters of the scale-up processes assigned to you (fermentation, biocatalysis, purification). You regularly take samples, analyse them in the lab, and critically evaluate the results, actively contributing ideas for potential improvements. Moreover, you act as a true ambassador for safety, structure, and hygiene in the process environment.

We're looking for a motivated weekend employee (2 x 12-hour nights per week + 2 x 8-hour days per month). You're a hands-on technician with a no-nonsense mentality who enjoys actively participating in innovative bio-based processes.

You work independently, methodically, and accurately, and you have knowledge of biotechnological processes such as fermentation or biocatalysis, or experience in process industry, chemistry, or food. Experience with bio-based products and processes is a plus. You are a real team player and communicate fluently in both Dutch and English.

The ideal candidate holds a bachelor’s degree in chemistry, biochemistry, HBO5 chemistry/biochemistry, or a laboratory technician diploma. In this case, previous work experience is not required. If you already have experience in the process industry, chemistry, or food sector, an A2 diploma (secondary education) in a scientific or technical field is also sufficient.

Nobody is perfect, at Bio Base Europe Pilot Plant, there is plenty of room to learn by doing! Can’t check every box above, but are you flexible, eager to learn, and open to tailored training? Do you enjoy taking on challenges, with a healthy dose of pioneer spirit running through your veins? Then don’t hesitate to get in touch!

Embark on an exciting career journey with a Traineeship in Recruitment & Sales, where you will develop expertise in matching talent with opportunities while honing your sales skills. This position offers a unique opportunity to grow within the business services industry in 1050 Bruxelles.

Client Details

Page Personnel is a recruitment agency specialized in placing junior to mid-level professionals in temporary and permanent roles across finance, sales, administration, and technical functions.

Description

As a Traineeship Recruitment & Sales professional, your responsibilities are:

• Managing the recruitment process from start to finish, including interviews and feedback.
• Preparing and presenting proposals to clients.
• Collaborating with the sales team to identify new business opportunities.

A successful Traineeship Recruitment & Sales professional should have:

• A degree in a relevant field such as business, human resources, or a related discipline.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• An ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
• A proactive attitude and a desire to learn and grow professionally.

• Proficiency in English, Dutch & French;

HEIMWEE is looking for social media & content interns for their 3 brands:
 
 

• MXDVS 

• Objects by Max Reynders 

• Garments by Max Reynders  

 
 

We work across clothing and furniture. As a small, hands-on team, everyone's work has a direct impact on how our brands look, feel, and grow.
 

We're looking for a Marketing Intern to join us on-site and help bring our three brands to life across social media and content. You'll work closely with the team to plan, create, and publish content that fits each brand's distinct identity while getting hands-on experience with the day-to-day of running marketing for a multi-brand company.
 

 
 

What you'll do
 
 

• Plan and create content (photo & video) for Instagram and TikTok across our three brands 

• Help maintain and grow our content calendar, keeping each brand consistent 

• Support community management: replying to comments and DMs, monitoring engagement, spotting trends and translating them into our identity 

• Assist with campaign planning around product launches and collections 

• Track and report on content performance, and help translate insights into next steps 

• Collaborate with the design and product teams to make sure marketing content reflects what's actually happening in the brands  

 
 

What we're looking for
 
 

• Currently studying marketing, communication, or a related field (or recently graduated) 

• A genuine interest in social media, content creation, fashion, and/or design 

• Comfortable creating content yourself 

• Familiar with Instagram, TikTok, and content/scheduling tools 

• Proactive, organized, and happy to work on-site as part of a small team 

• Fluent in English  

 
 

What we offer
 
 

• Hands-on experience across three distinct brands, from strategy to execution 

• A small creative team where your ideas are heard 

• Insight into how a multi-brand company in fashion and furniture actually operates  

 
 

How to apply
 

Send your CV, a short motivation and a portfolio or examples of content you've made to joske@maxreynders.com. We're excited to hear from you.

HEIMWEE is looking for Supply Chain Management interns for their 3 brands:
 
 

• MXDVS

We work across clothing and furniture. As a small, hands-on team, everyone's work has a direct impact on how our brands look, feel, and grow.
 

We're looking for a Supply Chain Management Intern to join us on-site and help keep production and logistics running smoothly across our three brands. What we offer
 
 

• Hands-on experience across three distinct brands, from strategy to execution 

• Real responsibility and visibility into how products move from supplier to customer 

• Insight into how a multi-brand company in fashion and furniture actually operates  

 
 

How to apply
 

Send your CV to joske@maxreynders.com. We're excited to hear from you.

At 
Bier Central Brussels, we're looking for a 
full-time Kitchen Crew Member to strengthen our team. We're not searching for the next Michelin-star chef (unless you secretly are one), but we are looking for someone who enjoys working in a professional kitchen, loves a lively atmosphere, and isn't afraid to roll up their sleeves when things get busy.
 

 
 

What you'll be doing:
 
 

• Helping prepare our delicious dishes. 

• Keeping the kitchen organized, clean, and efficient. 

• Working closely with an enthusiastic team that knows how to work hard and laugh even harder. 

• Delivering quality dishes, even when the restaurant is packed and the beer is flowing. 

* You already have some experience in a professional kitchen.
 

* You can communicate comfortably in 
English. If you speak additional languages, that's a huge bonus. 
 

* You live
